## Outcome

What user or product outcome does this change improve?

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Facts and inferences remain distinguishable.
- [ ] No user data is silently mutated.
- [ ] Sensitive content is not added to fixtures, logs, or screenshots.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] The primary iOS flow was checked manually.
- [ ] `_index/` and generated `docs/` are synchronized when knowledge changed.
